structuralIdentity.statement: For every COV_0 triangle feature, parity of the three-edge sum is identically zero for each of T_C,T_Z0,T_P0,T_Z1,T_P1,A_C,A_Z0,A_P0,A_Z1,A_P1.
structuralIdentity.consequence: All ten primitive marginal parity columns vanish identically. The only nonzero primitive column in the 11-bit family is ONE_PER_TRIANGLE parity.
structuralIdentity.explanation: For a fixed exchange coordinate over three vertices, pairwise difference support has even degree around a triangle; additionally |p-m| congruent p+m mod2. This is a triangle handshaking/parity conservation law.

interpretation: The surviving low scalar character is not any GF(2) linear conservation parity of the primitive marginal totals/absolute imbalances.
